Name: PelipperShowdown
Author: mask868
Description:
[center][b]Description[/b][/center]
[b]Pelipper Showdown Battles[/b] is the official battle expansion addon for [b]Pelipper Town[/b]. We have deeply integrated the [b]PokéShowdown[/b] battle engine into [i]Stardew Valley[/i], delivering a classic, hardcore, and mechanically complete turn-based Pokémon battle experience.
In the world of Pelipper Town, you can engage in strategic battles against wild Pokémon and NPC trainers; explore uniquely styled gym buildings and challenge Gym Leaders to collect badges; and forge deep bonds with your favorite NPCs through the all-new [b]Best Friend System[/b]. Additionally, just like in [i]Palworld[/i], you can pasture your Pokémon on the farm to automatically produce items and assist with farm work—build your very own automated Pokémon farm!

[b]！！！Please refer to the media image descriptions for more details![/b]

[b]🔧 This mod is under active development. If you have any suggestions or bug reports, feel free to leave a comment here or join my Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/XYXT3rHeR]https://discord.gg/XYXT3rHeR[/url][/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/XYXT3rHeR][/url]
[line]
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
Install SMAPI 4.5.2 or higher.Install Pelipper Town 1.2.1 or higher.Extract this mod and place both folders into your Stardew Valley/Mods/directory.Launch the game through SMAPI.⚠️ Note: Please make sure both folders from this mod are placed directly in the Modsroot directory. Missing either one will prevent the mod from functioning properly.[/list][line]
[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*]🐾 [b]Wild Encounters[/b] — Press [b]F[/b] while facing a naturally spawned Pokémon to enter a classic turn-based battle.[/*]
[*]🎯 [b]Catching System[/b] — Throw Poké Balls at any time during battle; supports post-battle leveling and mid-battle captures.[/*]
[*]🔄 [b]Data Sync[/b] — Battle data is read directly from the Pelipper Town base mod, including your pre-configured movesets, for seamless integration.[/*]
[*]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 [b]Trainer Battles[/b] — Battle any NPC trainer; [b]fully compatible with Pelipper Town's Trainer Tournaments[/b], completing matches in turn-based format to collect exclusive stickers![/*]
[*]🏛️ [b]Gym System[/b] — Includes gym buildings, [b]58 unique Gym Badge furniture pieces[/b], and [b]58 Gym NPC challenges[/b] of varying difficulty—defeat them all to collect every badge![/*]
[*]💝 [b]Best Friend System[/b] — The first NPC to reach [b]8 hearts[/b] of friendship with you will gift [b]10 Ultra Balls[/b] every day. On the [b]15th of each month[/b], they will also give you a random [b]Legendary Poké Ball[/b], which can summon a random legendary Pokémon ([b]1/3 chance of being Shiny[/b]).[/*]
[*]🐑 [b]Pokémon Pasture[/b] — Release your Pokémon onto the farm to automatically produce different items daily; choose from [b]5 automation work modes[/b] to help you water crops, harvest, mine, and more—completely freeing your hands![/*]
[*]🌐 [b]Multiplayer Support[/b] — Fully supports multiplayer mode; enjoy turn-based battles with your friends![/*]
[*][b]Added Pokémon Town Map[/b]
Starting from version 1.1.6, the mod adds a Pokémon Kanto-style town map. More content will be expanded in future updates. Currently, it includes Professor Oak's Lab, a Pokémon Gym, and some locked houses. You can enter the town from above the Bus Stop.
[b]Added NPCs[/b]
Professor Oak and RED have been added. Talk to them—they are quite interesting characters!
[b]2 New Cutscenes[/b]
Professor Oak and RED will now interact with you through brand-new cutscenes.
[b]Mobile Support[/b]
The mod now supports mobile! You can run it directly using the [b]Cinderbox[/b] launcher.
[b]Mod Configuration[/b]
Added config options to switch battle activation methods: press [b]F[/b] or [b]right-click[/b] on wild Pokémon to enter turn-based battles.[/*]
[/list][list]
